name: work-assignment-ticket-tool
description: Monorepo for Work Assignment Ticket Tool

scripts.backend:migrate: cd backend && venv\Scripts\python.exe manage.py makemigrations && venv\Scripts\python.exe manage.py migrate
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && venv\Scripts\pip.exe install -r requirements.txt
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run backend:migrate && npm run backend:seed
